release_notes_summary: Stable 0.9.14 adds GoPro CSV telemetry and braking analysis.
notes: Adds **GoPro Import / Braking Analysis** for exported GoPro telemetry CSV files.

Choose the timestamp and speed columns, confirm time and speed units, optionally map latitude/longitude, and select an inclusive record interval. Clearly labeled headers can suggest a mapping; the selected columns and units remain explicit.
Time supports elapsed seconds, milliseconds, and ISO8601 timestamps. Speed supports m/s, mph, km/h, and ft/s. The utility imports CSV exports and does not extract telemetry directly from MP4 files.

Results and Show Work report signed mean acceleration, braking-positive retardation, time-weighted segment retardation, speed-integrated distance, a separately labeled endpoint constant-acceleration estimate, and optional horizontal GPS path length. The interval table is included in copied results and printable Results output.

Retardation is a speed-change measure, not a tire-road friction coefficient. Speed-integrated distance assumes linear speed change between adjacent samples; horizontal GPS path is separate, excludes elevation, and is unavailable when selected-interval coordinates are incomplete. Samples are not smoothed.
